licenseNote: Original CodeManu author OGA release states CC0/public domain; itch description says public domain but itch license metadata says CC BY 4.0. Both facts retained, full attribution and project modifications recorded; not represented as uniformly CC0.
modifications: All selected 60fps PNG frames retained in order. Unity Texture2D/RenderTexture/Graphics.Blit alpha-weighted resampling into 256px cells (252px maximum content plus2px transparent gutter), proportional fit and centred letterboxing; top-left row-major atlas; transparent RGB cleaned; straight-alpha URP ParticleSystem material, complete lifetime curve, loop and non-loop prefabs. Source PNG bytes unchanged. No movie audio, actor likeness or gameplay code included.
scope: Actual Unity GPU atlas build and saved ParticleSystem settings/controlled BakeMesh UV read-back. All frames retained; not natural gameplay, full visible render/blend quality or WebGL acceptance.

animations.loopSamplingMethod: Continuous saved ParticleSystem playback, at most1/240s per Simulate call; exact second-cycle0..frameCount-1 UV and actual particle-age checks. Large-step sample is diagnostic only.
